CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

2. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation? (1 mark)
   A. Use Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation.
   C. Say Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams
